tasks.title: Implement the `todo` CLI
acceptance_criteria: AC1 — `list` works against a store file that does not exist. *(probe: TS-01)*
AC2 — `add` appends one item and confirms it. *(probe: TS-02)*
AC3 — `add` refuses empty text non-zero. *(probe: TS-03)*
AC5 — An out-of-range selector refuses the batch non-zero. *(probe: TS-04)*
AC6 — A batch removal resolves selectors against the ORIGINAL list. *(probe: TS-06)*
AC7 — `archive` drops the done items and prints the count. *(probe: TS-07)*
AC8 — `add` stores and echoes the item text as INV-06 defines it. *(probe: TS-08)*

_comment: Paths are relative to THIS directory, so the same order is valid whether it is read from the example folder or from a workspace seeded with `spec/` and `build/`.
